title: Opinion: Grand Theft Auto VI and World of Warcraft: Forever show that mundanity is having a moment
description: Two of the year's biggest hits tell us that downtime and doldrums can be as compelling as dungeons and dragons.

title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO weeks after his resignation
description: The ousted CEO has been reinstated by the board less than two weeks after his ouster, in consultation with senior officials from the United States government.

title: Epic Games no longer plans to include Blueprints or Actor Gameplay Framework in Unreal Engine 6
description: Until recently Epic had maintained that both features would initially remain options in Unreal Engine with plans to wind down the features over time, but now Blueprints and the Actor Gameplay Framework have been dropped in favor of support for AI driven tools.

title: Devs can now utilize the high-end ambient occlusion technique seen in EVE: Frontier
description: CORTAO, a personal programming project by Fenris Creations developer Daniel Isheden, is being used for EVE: Frontier, and maybe your next game.

title: Grand Theft Auto VI is now the biggest video game launch in history
description: Day-one retails sales for Grand Theft Auto VI crossed $3.79 billion, and Take-Two sold 32.5 million copies before the game even released.

title: Ubisoft misses forecast and bets big on AI development
description: The French publisher plunges on first-half year earnings, though has a few bright spots in its portfolio.

title: Is Control Resonant's protagonist a 'sad wet man?' ft. Mikael Kasurinen
description: We're chatting with creative director Mikael Kasurinen about the process of making the challenging development decisions behind Control Resonant.

title: Ubisoft lays off 166 in Canada across Montréal and Quebec City
description: The cuts come from the Montréal and Quebec City offices, two studios that have historically benefited from sizable subsidies offered by the Canadian government to bolster the country's game development industry.

title: Why greenlighting Dressmaker wasn't an easy decision to make
description: Pre-production data said Dressmaker might not find an audience. Free Lives pushed past those numbers to make a bona fide hit.

title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33's narrative lead wants to change game funding
description: After winning numerous awards, Clair Obscur narrative lead Jennifer Svedberg-Yen wants to change the story about priorities in game funding.

title: PlayStation emerges victorious in a $2.6 billion lawsuit alleging a digital monopoly
description: The now-dismissed lawsuit accused PlayStation of setting "excessive and unfair prices" in the UK, but will not proceed any further.

title: European Game Worker unions publish manifesto warning against unchecked AI usage
description: Members in Ireland, Spain, and Milan have come together to outline concerns, grievances, pitfalls, and proposed solutions surrounding Generative AI use.

title: Zelda and Grand Theft Auto headline the nominees for the 2027 Game Awards
description: The numerous categories of The Game Awards were largely dominated by Grand Theft Auto VI and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, but there's plenty to talk about in this year's nominees.

title: This year's video game Grammy nominations reveal Academy's potential favor against songs with vocals
description: The Grammys are celebrating a suite of stellar video game soundtracks—but one indie dev says the academy rejected their score for being heavy on vocals.

title: Take-Two lays off Firaxis employees on eve of Grand Theft Auto VI launch
description: Firaxis, a sibling studio to Take-Two's Rockstar Games, is known for games like Sid Meier's Civilization VII and Marvel's Midnight Suns.

title: The History of Every Video Game Genre
description: From racing and sports, to shoot 'em ups and platformers, to fighting games and first-person shooters, to cozy games and friendslop, this is the history of every video game genre. Ever.

title: Word Play is now available on iOS!
description: Word Play is now available on iPhone and iPad. Get the free trial here

title: 100 Steam Games that started life during GMTK Game Jam
description: There are more than 100 games on Steam that started life during one of our GMTK Game Jam events. To celebrate these amazing developers, let's look at 100 games that made the jump from jam to Steam.

title: How I Coded the Perks in my Roguelike
description: Word Play is my vocabulary roguelike, with over 100 passive perks. Implementing them into the game meant learning a whole new type of coding architecture: inheritance.

title: The Secrets Behind THAT Cyberpunk 2077 Montage
description: Here's a super quick bonus video, looking at the famous montage from Cyberpunk 2077. How did CD Projekt Red make a cinematic sequence with 15 location changes, 79 cuts, and three mirror shots? Let's find out.

title: How Rockstar fit an entire city into PlayStation 2 memory
description: With Grand Theft Auto III, Rockstar North performed a magic trick: it squeezed an entire 4 kilometre wide city into the tiny 32 megabyte chip of the PlayStation 2. Here's how they did it.

title: Has Zelda Changed Forever?
description: The Legend of Zelda series turns 40 years old this month. Let's look at the two distinct eras of the franchise, ask why Nintendo made the shift, and look at what might come next.

title: The World Design of Hollow Knight: Silksong
description: Team Cherry returns to the world of Hollow Knight with Silksong - a new game, with a new character, in a whole new world. In this episode of Boss Keys let's look at how the developers designed Pharloom and the Citadel, and how they thought about topics like progression, backtracking, and optional content.

title: What's the Point of Prototyping?
description: With a game idea under your belt, it's time to test it out. And the best way to do that is with a prototype. Find out why, and get tips for making your own, in episode two of Game Dev 101.

title: How Games Do Destruction
description: Let's talk about video game destruction, and break down the techniques used to dent cars, break boxes, tear through scenery, and blow up buildings.

title: What's The Point Of Hard Games, Anyway?
description: Hollow Knight: Silksong is the latest game to join the "difficulty in games" debate. In this Mini episode of GMTK, let's look at why, and how, designers implement a high level of challenge in their games.

title: My Favourite Games from GMTK Game Jam 2025
description: This year's GMTK Game Jam was all about loops. Here are 20 of my favourite entries to the jam - from programming chefs to time-travelling crows.
